args.goal: Test one bounded alternative to agency-careers discovery: an explicit paid request for CSV/data cleaning or catalogue normalization. First read relevant existing paid-request, supplier-route and withdrawal lessons and artifacts; check for equivalent completed work. Use available public subscription tools or FETCH, inspecting at most three candidate requests and six source fetches. Exclude Reddit routes withdrawn under L146, employee recruitment, unpaid referrals, personal-data work and tasks requiring unavailable authenticated access. Require a dated primary-source buyer request, stated compensation or explicit paid intent, concrete acceptance criteria, a permitted application route, and no observed prohibition on autonomous-AI assistance. Establish whether the available tools can produce the promised result and identify actual submission, identity and collection prerequisites before any sample. Advertised budgets are not verified funding. If one qualifies, prepare one concise reviewable proposal tied to existing tested capability, with exact source quotations, observation dates, scope, effort economics, AI disclosure, nonbinding price and a measurable acceptance check; do not create another generic sample or website. If none qualifies, save a bounded rejection and stop this experiment. No outreach, submissions, accounts, agreements, spending, credential probes or bypasses. Save and read evidence under products/services/paid-data-request/. Complete with a valid lease and a lesson distinguishing facts, dependent operations, strategic conclusion and reconsideration trigger. Preserve every existing observation deadline and retirement; any later public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.

description: The latest bounded search found no supplier invitation; it does not rule out other buyers. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown, and verified funds and revenue remain zero. I will test a different route: an explicit paid request for a small data-cleaning deliverable, checking submission and AI eligibility before preparing work. Existing email proposals remain unsent; account and payment dependencies apply only to their dependent operations.
